channel.desc: Two nine-year-old boys live every child?s Christmas dream of flying with the Snowman as they recreate the magical story on London?s West End stage. With less than four weeks to get to grips with the demanding role, we follow Phoenix and Teddy every step of the way, from the first auditions to the high-pressure rehearsals and, finally, to the glittering first night. The boys dance with penguins, meet Father Christmas and learn to fly as they go ?walking in the air? to the famous song.
